summary: The high-stakes world of orchestrated busts and undercover police sting operations, some of the most powerful and effective tools in the law-enforcement arsenal.

name: Тень стрекозы
summary:
Based on a novel by Tatiana Polyakova. A mysterious murder happens in the native town of a Moscow journalist Lana (Karina Razumovskaya).

Her old friend Svetlana (Anastasia Privalova) was killed. She was an eccentric person, who always tried to imitate her more successful friend.

Weird messages left by the deceased force Lana to start her own investigation. It seems that Lanas beloved is involved in the death of her friend - Special Forces soldier Valera (Grigoriy Kirdyashkin) who disappeared five years ago and who bore a nickname of "Dragonfly".

The desire to justify Valera and dispel her own suspicions brings Lana into trouble: someone remaining in the shadows is clearly trying to let her know - she would follow Svetlana, if she does not leave the town.

name: Экстрасенсы против детективов
summary:
A grand battle between intuition and deduction, premonition and logic! For the first time in the history of Russian television, investigators, operatives and forensic experts of the Ministry of Internal Affairs will fight with the owners of paranormal abilities - shamans, witches and parapsychologists.

According to the rules of the project, the teams will have to solve real crimes. They will receive a compressed dossier and a set of evidence on a criminal case. After that, the psychics and detectives will have only 12 hours to describe the personality of the alleged criminal and tell the details of the incident. After this time, a secret witness who knows absolutely everything about the crime under investigation will determine the winner.
Psychics and detectives will have to work in a team, give up their ambitions and constantly listen to their colleagues. With each episode, the relationship between the players will become more tense, because once a week the losing side will have to part with the one who, in the team's opinion, turned out to be the weakest link. The participants of the show "Psychics vs. Detectives" will compete for a large cash prize of 5 million rubles. To do this, the players will have to forget about personal ambitions for a while and defend the honor of the team. In the final of each program, the losing side must lose one of the participants by voting. But when there is very little left to victory, will the finalists remember those without whom this success would not have been possible?

name: Секрет на миллион
summary:
On this unusual talk show, celebrities can win big by revealing their deepest secrets and correctly answering tricky questions from celebrity agent provocateur Lera Kudryavtseva.

The host will ask the contestants questions, each connected to their real lives and worth its own price. What was the name of your shop teacher? What dress did you wear on your first date? Why is your ex-wife upset with you? And who did you spend the night with at the Côte d'Azur hotel? The more revelations you reveal, the bigger the prize!

The contestants can only use their veto power once. Which artist will be brave enough to reach the end and answer the most piquant question worth 1 million rubles?

If you think the contestants will be able to fool the blonde Kudryavtseva, you're mistaken: her agents will dig up the dirtiest skeletons from the artists' closets. On the set of the show "Secret for a Million," the players will meet people they dreamed of meeting years later, and those they'd like to forget forever... And all this in order to tell the truth about the celebrity guest.

name: Angel's Friends
summary: Special school for the Angels is full of secrets! What happens if at the same table will be angels and devils? Raf, Uri, Sweet and Mickey - a company of angels. But to become a real team, they do not have a single person. Friends leave their homes and go down to the Earth in the "Golden School". They need to get the last "missing percentage", which will make their guardian angels at 100%. Their mission is to accompany selected earthlings in their daily adventures...

name: Dance Moms: Miami
summary: Just when you thought Lifetime's hit docu-series Dance Moms couldn't get more fiery or passionate, the franchise heads south to the hot and sultry beaches of Florida with the premiere of Dance Moms: Miami on Tuesday, April 3, 2012, at 10:30 pm ET/PT -- immediately following the 90-minute spring finale of the network's flagship dance competition docusoap, Dance Moms. Beginning Tuesday, April 10, Dance Moms: Miami will air in its regular time period of 9:00 PM ET/PT. Dance Moms: Miami will go behind-the-scenes at Miami-based Stars Dance Studio, where the school's owners and renowned contemporary dance instructors Victor Smalley and Angel Armas teach, train and choreograph a diverse group of talented girl and boy dancers as they strive to become the best in the sport of competitive dance and tomorrow's stars. Born and raised in Miami, Victor has become well known throughout the dance world for his cutting-edge choreography, with his first big break as a finalist on season six of the hit show, So You Think You Can Dance. Angel was born in Sagua La Grande, Villa Clara, Cuba. At the age of 12 his passion for dance ignited when he began taking lessons in ballroom dance and now his choreography is in high demand by local TV shows, concerts, and artists.

name: Journey to the Hammers: King of the Motos
summary: If you're a fan of rock buggies and desert racing, ULTRA4 Racing and King of the Hammers (KOH) just dropped some awesome news! Starting next week, NBC Sports will air a six episode series titled Journey to the Hammers: King of the Motos on Thursday nights. This series showcases the drivers, teams and the lifestyle of ULTRA4 Racing.

name: Anh's Brush with Fame
summary:
Beloved artist, actor and comedian Anh Do uses his passion for painting as a vehicle to explore the stories behind some of Australia's most intriguing and prolific personalities in this intimate and revealing new interview series.

Featuring deeply personal conversations, Archibald Prize finalist Anh creates a vivid portrait of Australian celebrity, taking his subjects on a cathartic and authentic journey of self-discovery. Drawing inspiration from archival footage, photos from each guest's private collection and the sheer power of a portrait sitting, Anh allows the stories he uncovers to inform the beautiful paintings he brings to life - revealing a side of these household names that both enlightens and surprises even them.

name: World Cup Qualifier Highlights
summary: Highlights of World Cup Qualifiers.

name: Cycling: Tour of Britain Highlights
summary: The Tour of Britain, with an all-star cast set for the eight-day race.

name: WWW.WORKING!!
summary: Daisuke Higashida is a serious first-year student at Higashizaka High School. He lives a peaceful everyday life even though he is not satisfied with the family who doesn't laugh at all and makes him tired. However, his father's company goes bankrupt one day, and he can no longer afford allowances, cellphone bills, and commuter tickets. When his father orders him to take up a part-time job, Daisuke decides to work at a nearby family restaurant in order to avoid traveling 15 kilometers to school by bicycle.

name: Down with Love
summary: Shiang Yu Ping, a divorce and inheritance lawyer, is seen by others as cold, selfish, and ruthless. He had taken in his brother's orphans and was in need of a nanny. But after he exhausted his supply of nannies, he still couldn't find one who doesn't fall in love with him or gets scared off by the kids. Fed up, Yu Ping asks his secretary, Yang Duo, to find a nanny that meets his requirements. She recommends her younger sister, Yang Guo, for the job; assuring Yu Ping that her tomboyish sister will not fall in love with him by lying that she does not like men at all.

name: Mobster Confessions
summary: Real-life gangsters look back at their lives of crime as mafia informants come out of hiding to tell their stories.

name: Crime Story
summary: The saga of a Chicago police detective's efforts to stop a young hood's ruthless rise in the ranks of organized crime. Former cop Dennis Farina plays Lt. Mike Torello, a no-nonsense cop who, as head of Chicago's Major Crime Unit in the early '60s, occasionally finds it necessary to bend the rules. The serial follows the relationships between Torello, rising mobster Ray Luca (Anthony Denison) and lawyer David Abrams (Stephen Lang), the son of a former gangster.

name: BORDER
summary:
Ishikawa Ango is a detective with smarts and a keen sense of observation. He's in a great physical shape and also highly ambitious. Ango also only focuses on his work and his personal life is pretty much non-existent.

One day, a former police officer is killed by a gun shot. Ango goes to the scene of the crime, but is shot in the head by the killer who is lurking at the crime scene. Ango hovers between life and death. At that time, he thinks to himself "where do people go after they die?" and then "I don't want to die." A miracle then happens. Ango survives with the bullet still lodged in his head. He goes back to work.

A new murder case takes place. When Ango goes to the crime scene he notices a boy who looks like he is about to cry, but only Ango is able to see the boy. The boy is the one who was killed. Since Ango was shot, he can now see and talk with the dead.

name: Dog and Cat
summary: Sgt. Jack Ramsey, an undercover detective with the Los Angeles Police Department, found himself teamed with a very green partner named J.Z. Kane. Together they formed a relationship based on friendship and trust (completely platonic) that led to them capturing many of L.A.'s criminals.

name: Scotland and the Battle for Britain
summary:
Scotsman, broadcaster and former BBC Political Editor Andrew Marr presents this two-part documentary which explores Scotland's political transformation during the historic events of the last few years. The programmes look at the impact of the Scottish Referendum, the success of the SNP in last year's General Election and what the Brexit vote means for the future of Scotland.

The documentary will feature interviews with top names in Scottish and British politics, past and present, including the current leader of the SNP, Nicola Sturgeon, former SNP leader Alex Salmond, former Prime Minister Tony Blair, former Labour MP Brian Wilson, Alistair Darling MP and Baroness Helen Liddell.

The programme also contains interviews with academics Professor John Curtice and Sir Tom Devine. The two, hour long programmes will bring viewers a fascinating insight into these significant political events and what they mean for Scotland today and in the future with Andrew exploring the likelihood of a second independence referendum.

name: Nyerő Páros
summary: Each season of the highly successful reality show, several couples move in together to decide the Winning Couple of the Year at the end of a week-long battle hosted by Balázs Sebestyén. The secret to winning is the same as the secret to a good relationship: only those who know their partner, trust their decisions, are good at taking obstacles and navigate the mazes of love as skilfully as they do in this game can win.

name: Animals Unleashed
summary: Animals Unleashed is a user-generated content show that features unpredictable and hilarious animal clips from around the world.

name: Stage School
summary: A new series following the lives of students and teachers at a real-life stage school.

name: Koukussa
summary: Drug Crime Detective Oskari is the envy of his colleagues. His connections to underworld and informants is unrivaled. What they don't know is the mother of his child, Krista, is a drug addict who lives in that world. And now she's back in his life, shaking his home life on one hand, and offering new connections to knocking down the rise of drug imports. If only he could trust her.

name: Paralympics 2016 Highlights
summary: Clare Balding presents daily highlights of the Paralympic Games in Rio de Janeiro, but first the Opening Ceremony.
